    StartersE.B.'s jellybean rocky roadMilk chocolate with mini marshmallows and jellybeansHow to make it400g milk chocolate20g butter100g mini marshmallows150g jellybeans60g pretzels, broken30g shredded coconutLine a 20cm square tin with baking paper.Melt the chocolate with the butter in a bowl over simmering water, then cool briefly.Stir in the marshmallows, most of the jellybeans, pretzels and coconut.Spread into the tin and press more jellybeans on top.Chill until set, then cut into squares with a hot knife.Rainbow carrots with green goddess dipRainbow baby carrots and snow peas with avocado herb dipHow to make it2 bunches of rainbow baby carrots150g snow peas1 avocado150g Greek yoghurt1 small bunch basil1 small bunch parsley1 small bunch chives1 lemon, juiced1 tbsp sunflower seeds, toastedTrim the carrots, leaving a little green top, and halve any big ones lengthways.Blanch the snow peas briefly and cool in iced water.Blitz the avocado, yoghurt, basil, parsley, chives, lemon juice and salt until smooth.Spoon into a bowl, scatter with sunflower seeds and serve with the vegetables.MainsFred O'Hare's Hollywood loaded hot dogsHot dogs with cheddar sauce, corn relish and crispy onionsHow to make it8 frankfurts20g butter1 tbsp plain flour200ml full cream milk100g cheddar, grated200g tin corn kernels, drained2 tbsp tomato relish8 hot dog buns1 bottle tomato sauce4 tbsp crispy fried onionsSimmer the frankfurts, then grill until marked.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then stir in the cheddar.Mix the corn with the relish.Toast the buns and fill with frankfurts, cheese sauce, corn relish and tomato sauce.Top with crispy fried onions.O'Hare family Easter roast lambFred's dad wants him out of the house by Easter SundayHow to make it2kg lamb leg, bone in4 garlic cloves1 rosemary3 tbsp olive oil1kg roasting potatoes2 bunches of baby carrots1 tbsp honey1 mint3 tbsp white wine vinegar1 tbsp caster sugarHeat the oven to 200°C. Cut small slits in the lamb and push in garlic slivers and rosemary. Rub with 1 tbsp of the oil and salt.Roast the lamb for 1 and a half hours, with the parboiled potatoes in 1 tbsp of the oil on another tray.Toss the carrots with the rest of the oil and the honey and roast for the last 30 minutes.Chop the mint and mix with the vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp boiling water.Rest the lamb for 15 minutes, carve and serve with the vegetables and mint sauce.SweetsEaster Island chocolate crackle nestsMilk chocolate and cornflake nests baked in muffin casesHow to make it200g milk chocolate30g butter1 tbsp golden syrup80g cornflakes150g mini chocolate eggsMelt the chocolate with the butter and golden syrup.Stir in the cornflakes until coated.Spoon into paper cases in a muffin tin, pressing a dip in the centre of each with the back of a teaspoon.Chill until set.Fill each nest with mini chocolate eggs.DrinksCarrot, orange and ginger sunriseFresh carrot, orange and ginger juice with raspberry cordialHow to make it6 carrots5 oranges1 knob ginger4 tbsp raspberry cordial1 bag iceJuice the carrots, four oranges and the ginger, or blend with a little water and strain through a sieve.Chill the juice.Fill glasses with ice and pour in the juice.Slowly pour a spoon of raspberry cordial down the inside of each glass so it sinks.
